name: Coordinate Conditioning
definition: For H ⊆ 2^X, x ∈ X, and ε ∈ {0,1}, fix the membership value of x and then remove x: H_x^ε = {h ∖ {x} : h ∈ H and 1_{x∈h}=ε} ⊆ 2^{X ∖ {x}}.
comments: In the one-inclusion graph this is restriction to one coordinate semicube. Iterated nonempty conditionings give cube-face sections; arbitrary convex restrictions may fix several semicubes in succession.
